summary: Frontend-only regression after Expo SDK 54 -> 58 upgrade (expo 58.0.17, RN 0.88, React 19.3, @react-native-vector-icons/ionicons 14). Viewport 390x844. ALL requested flows PASS with zero console errors / pageerrors and no red screen: login (tecnico@lab.it) -> Home; Archivio filter chips (Tutte/Emesse/Bozze), Filtri bottom sheet + DateField (filter-date-from) opens and closes via backdrop, Seleziona mode (4 checkboxes, select-all selects 3 issued, '3 selezionate'), print-selected triggers Print.printAsync on web without error, exit-select restores normal mode; Anagrafica segments (clients/materials); Magazzino empty state; Profilo rows Fatturazione (/billing), Tipi di lavorazione (/work-types), Impostazioni provider (/provider-settings) all navigate and back. Ionicons: font 'Ionicons' reported loaded in document.fonts, every Ionicons text node renders a PUA glyph (0 empty / 0 fallback ASCII) on all screens; visual screenshots confirm no tofu boxes. Declaration wizard /declaration/new: patient -> 2 works added (Protesi Fissa / two subtypes) -> step 3 DateField modal opens, month nav works, backdrop tap closes, day pick sets '15/10/2026' and closes; exited wizard without saving (no draft persisted, verified via API). Billing: seeded TEST invoice, detail renders, Cedolino iframe 'Cedolino pre-fattura' renders lines (TEST_Rossi/TEST_Bianchi), Fattura preview renders 4-col header; invoice deleted afterwards (200). expo-doctor: 20/20 checks passed. No deprecated packages (expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch, @expo/vector-icons) found.

Not upgrade-related; cosmetic (A4 print is fine). Note header differs from iteration_10 (6 cols, 'Elem.') — confirm intended.
Signature shows a broken-image icon — signature_base64 on this seeded declaration appears invalid. Pre-existing test data, not upgrade-related.
